notes.title: Revenant March Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36440894/05099452ff8546c5b245ec0ae59c3457c8dc84bc.png[/img]

To celebrate Steam's first ever Visual Novel sale, we've released a free demo for Revenant March! 

The demo contains all the functionality of Revenant March, but you'll only be able to advance to a certain point in Olenine's story. After purchasing the full game, you can load any save from the demo and continue right where you left off. 

As our debut title, Revenant March was born out of two people's belief in the potential of visual novels to craft stories that can't be experienced any other way. We're excited about the opportunity to show you what these kinds of games are all about and hope you enjoy the many twists and turns that Gremach has to offer.
